evidence_type: read-only static analysis; not a live lobby-switch or hidden-user test

findings.subject: hidden_user_state
findings.observed: A static dictionary contains per-user IsHidden values. The setter updates this cache and the cat GameObject active state. Awake clears the cache.
findings.limit: No external export call found in the inspected hide path; this does not prove that no supported integration exists elsewhere. Persistence across lifecycle changes was not tested.

findings.subject: game_display_policies
findings.observed: Speech display returns if the GameObject is inactive. Incoming speech checks MuteChats and ChatLanguageFilter. Member startup also considers AutoHideCats.
findings.limit: Rendering behavior and sidecar reception while a user is hidden were not exercised.

findings.subject: existing_probe_limits
findings.observed: The observation loop has no product lobby-switch state machine or game visibility-state integration. The single-send script rejects an unexpected target and rechecks the current lobby before calling the send API.
findings.limit: A state recheck is not an atomic transaction with a separate game's lobby change.

official_api_constraints.constraint: Only valid within the callback scope; must not be stored as a durable message identifier.
Documented for friend game information; current-account use in the separate-process PoC remains an observed behavior requiring compatibility tests.

privacy: No user IDs, lobby IDs, chat contents, game binaries or decompiled method bodies included.
